brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare the hormonal, metabolic and clinical effects of metformin and liraglutide in infertile women with PCOs.
brief_title: Effect of Liraglutide in Obese Women With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women aged 18-45 years
* Poly cystic ovary syndrome based on the Rotterdam criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

1. congenital adrenal hyperplasia,
2. poorly controlled thyroid disease
3. Taking antidiabetic drugs which can affect insulin resistance
4. chronic kidney disease
5. liver dysfunction (AST or ALT
6. Documented use of oral hormonal contraceptives and hormone-releasing implants
7. intolerance or allergy to liraglutide or metformin

official_title: Effect of Liraglutide on Different Parameters (Clinical , Metabolic and Hormonal) in Obese Women With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
